astrologyConsultation.subtitle: Consult expert astrologers for birth chart analysis, planetary defect remedies, auspicious timing, and predictions.

intro.title: Vedic Astrology Guidance
intro.desc1: Vedic Astrology (Jyotish) is an ancient Indian science that reveals the cosmic influences on our lives based on planetary positions at the time of birth. Our expert astrologers provide accurate predictions, practical remedies, and guidance to help you navigate life's challenges and maximize opportunities.
intro.desc2: Whether you're facing career decisions, relationship issues, health concerns, or seeking spiritual growth, our astrology consultations offer clarity and direction based on your unique birth chart.

freeAnalysis.title: Free Basic Horoscope Analysis
freeAnalysis.desc: First-time clients receive a free basic birth chart analysis including planetary positions, rising sign, and key life themes. Book your consultation today to claim this offer.

complete.title: Complete Birth Chart Analysis
complete.desc: Comprehensive analysis of your Janam Kundali including all 12 houses, 9 planets, 27 nakshatras, and planetary aspects.

defects.title: Planetary Defect Remedies
defects.desc: Identification of malefic planetary influences (Grah Dosh) and personalized Vedic remedies to neutralize negative effects.
features: Analysis of Kaal Sarp Dosh, Mangal Dosh, etc.

muhurta.title: Muhurta (Auspicious Timing)
muhurta.desc: Selecting the most favorable timing for important life events based on planetary transits and nakshatra positions.

relationship.title: Relationship & Compatibility
relationship.desc: In-depth analysis of relationship compatibility for marriage, business partnerships, and family harmony.

career.title: Career & Finance Guidance
career.desc: Astrological guidance for career advancement, business growth, financial investments, and wealth accumulation.

question.title: Question-Based Consultation
question.desc: Focused consultation addressing 3 specific questions about any area of life - career, health, relationships, or spirituality.

systems.title: Astrological Systems We Use
systems.parashariDesc1: The most widely used system of Vedic astrology, named after Sage Parashara. This system forms the foundation of most Hindu astrology practiced today.
systems.parashariDesc2: We analyze planetary positions in 12 houses, 27 nakshatras, and calculate various dashas (planetary periods) including Vimshottari Dasha (120-year cycle). This system provides comprehensive life predictions including career, relationships, health, and spiritual growth.
systems.parashariDesc3: Special techniques used: Ashtakavarga, Shadbala, Vargas (Divisional charts), and Transit analysis (Gochara).
systems.jyotishDesc1: The traditional science of light that encompasses both predictive astrology and spiritual guidance. Jyotish means 'light of the divine.'
systems.jyotishDesc2: Beyond mere prediction, this system focuses on understanding karmic patterns and providing remedies to improve one's destiny. It incorporates spiritual practices, mantras, yantras, and gemstone therapy to harmonize planetary influences.
systems.jyotishDesc3: Special features: Karmic analysis, past life indications, spiritual evolution guidance, and integration with Vedic rituals and practices.
systems.nadiDesc1: An ancient system where predictions are based on palm leaf manuscripts written by sages thousands of years ago. These leaves contain records of individuals' lives.
systems.nadiDesc2: We use principles from Nadi astrology to provide remarkably specific predictions about past, present, and future events. This system is especially powerful for identifying past life karmas and their present effects.
systems.nadiDesc3: Key applications: Identifying root causes of current problems, precise event timing, relationship karmas, and specific remedial measures from ancient texts.
systems.keralaDesc1: The unique astrological tradition from Kerala known for its precision in Muhurta (auspicious timing) and Prashna (horary astrology).
systems.keralaDesc2: This system excels in answering specific questions and selecting perfect timing for important events. It incorporates unique techniques like KP System (Krishnamurti Paddhati) for precise predictions.
systems.keralaDesc3: Specialties: Accurate answer to specific questions, pinpoint timing for events, marriage matching, and business success timing.

elements.title: What We Analyze in Your Chart
elements.lagnaDesc: Ascendant, Sun, Moon, and all 9 planets with their strengths and influences.
elements.housesDesc: Analysis of all 12 Bhavas covering every aspect of life from self to liberation.
elements.nakshatrasDesc: Lunar mansions that provide deeper insights into personality and destiny.
elements.dashaDesc: Planetary periods and sub-periods that time life events with precision.
elements.yogasDesc: Special planetary combinations that create unique life patterns and opportunities.

elements.remediesDesc: Personalized solutions including gems, mantras, pujas, and lifestyle changes.
elements.lifePathDesc: Direction for career, relationships, health, and spiritual development.
